answer_2.quote: Following , our calibration data consists of 128 random segments of the C4 dataset . We benchmark accuracy on LLaMA-2 , LLaMA-3 families (Meta, 2024), and Mistral . Following previous work , we report perplexity on language modeling tasks (WikiText-2 , C4 ). We also employ lm-eval-harness  to perform zero-shot evaluations on common sense QA benchmarks (PIQA , HellaSwag , WinoGrande , ARC ).
